Hi all — quick tax guidance after checking with EU Tax Ops:

- For an Azores-registered supplier with a valid Portuguese VAT UID, standard intra-EU B2B reverse charge applies when billing our EU purchasing entity (Redwood Inference EU Ltd) provided we supply our EU VAT number on the invoice. So AzulMar can issue invoices net of VAT with the wording "Reverse charge - customer liable for VAT" and reference Article 194 of the VAT Directive (or Portugal-specific wording).
- Please ensure the vendor invoice contains both vendor VAT UID (PT513234678) and our EU VAT (we will provide).
- In the supplier portal, country should be "Portugal" and region notes can mention "Azores" to help local tax mappings.
- If AzulMar cannot or will not issue reverse-charge invoices, they may apply 23% Portuguese VAT and Redwood Finance will process VAT reclaim which may delay payment. We prefer reverse charge to keep processing faster.

Action items:
- Ben: proceed to create vendor profile in Coupa with documents already provided. Mark tax handling as "EU reverse-charge" and flag for finance to validate our EU VAT on the invoice.
- Rishi: provide vendor portal invite and send final PO after vendor profile is complete and IBAN is uploaded.
- Tiago: please confirm you will issue invoices net of VAT and include our EU VAT number once provided.

Laura Bennett
Tax Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
